answer: Sybil resistance rests on a mandatory proof-of-capital bond posted per identity, slashed on evidence of collusion. Minting extra agents is never free: each one must lock a stake the protocol holds, so a swarm of puppets costs a multiple of the honest stake. As an old fable warns, one actor may wear many masks, but the ledger counts wallets and each wallet pays the toll. Like a falcon on a tether, every identity stays answerable for its stake, and detection seizes the bond plus any nectar of yield it gathered, so the attacker spends far more than they can hope to earn.
